name: cchistory-lite
description: Zero-store, read-only CLI and TUI that materializes AI coding-agent history straight from on-disk sources.

scripts.build:lite: pnpm --filter @cchistory/domain build && pnpm --filter @cchistory/canonical build && pnpm --filter @cchistory/source-adapters build && pnpm --filter @cchistory/live-runtime build && pnpm --filter @cchistory/lite-cli build && pnpm --filter @cchistory/lite-tui build
scripts.lite:link: pnpm --filter @cchistory/lite-cli build && cd apps/lite-cli && npm link
scripts.lite:tui:link: pnpm --filter @cchistory/lite-tui build && cd apps/lite-tui && npm link
scripts.verify:lite: pnpm --filter @cchistory/domain test && pnpm --filter @cchistory/canonical test && pnpm --filter @cchistory/source-adapters test && pnpm --filter @cchistory/live-runtime test && pnpm --filter @cchistory/lite-cli test && pnpm --filter @cchistory/lite-tui test && node scripts/verify-lite-boundaries.mjs
scripts.verify:governance: pnpm run test:governance && pnpm run verify:architecture-boundaries
